# Laotie Steel Structure

> Laotie Steel Structure Co., Ltd. is a CE & ISO certified steel structure manufacturer in China. Founded in 2009, with 5 production lines and 5,000T/month capacity, serving 30+ countries. Products include steel warehouses, factory buildings, workshops, space frames, floor decks, sandwich panels, and prefab container houses. Factory-direct pricing, FOB China shipping, global export.

## Products

- [Steel Warehouse](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/steel-warehouse): Custom steel warehouse buildings with clear span design
- [Steel Factory Building](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/steel-factory-building): Manufacturing plant steel structures with crane systems
- [Steel Workshop](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/steel-workshop): Cost-effective workshop buildings for industrial use
- [Steel Structure Building](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/steel-structure-building): Portal frame buildings for various applications
- [Floor Deck](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/floor-deck): Steel floor decking for multi-story buildings
- [Space Frame Truss](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/space-frame-truss): Long-span space frame roof structures
- [Insulated Sandwich Panel](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/insulated-sandwich-panel): EPS/PU/rockwool insulated wall and roof panels
- [Galvanized C/Z Purlin](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/galvanized-cz-purlin): Cold-formed steel purlins for roof and wall systems
- [PPGI Color Coated Steel](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/ppgi-color-coated-steel): Pre-painted galvanized steel coils and sheets
- [Prefab Container House](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/prefab-container-house): Modular container houses for temporary or permanent use
- [FRP Skylight Sheet](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/frp-skylight-sheet): Fiberglass reinforced plastic daylighting panels
- [Hot Rolled Steel Coil](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/hot-rolled-steel-coil): HR steel coils for structural fabrication
- [Crane Beam](https://www.laotie-steel.com/products/crane-beam): Overhead crane runway beams for industrial buildings
